** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• India has about 190 ports, with 13 major and the rest intermediate and minor.
 
• The largest port in India is Jawaharlal Nehru Port in Mumbai.
 
• The largest natural port is in Vishakhapatnam.
 
• Mumbai Port is the busiest port in India.
 
• Large ports are maintained by the Central Government whereas small ports are included in the concurrent list and are managed by the State Government.
 
• Tuticorin is an artificial deep-sea dock and is also known as VO Chidambaranar Port.
 
• Ennore Port is also known as Kamarajar Port Limited.
